provenance: Public/synthetic corpus for the plan-164 posting↔catalog matching golden benchmark (plan 50 P2b/P2c.2). The original 17-case P2b slice is kept verbatim; the P2c.2 expansion adds seven synthetic families (operations, sales, cybersecurity, education, legal, research, hospitality) with clear matches, wrong deterministic winners, below-threshold lifts, margin/threshold abstentions, draft-gated candidates, family-only/S3-pending rows, no-shared-skill rows, manual rows and terminal postings. All names, roles, skills and descriptions are synthetic; no private-integration or scraped personal data is present. The semantic column is a pinned oracle for the rerank policy; the real vector match is covered by test_vector_retrieval_service.py and test_semantic_rerank.py.

scale.note: 164 cases / 123 jobs / 13 families. candidate_recall@25 is a real ceiling because the catalog exceeds K=25; family-only rows are S3-pending coverage and manual/terminal rows are invariant checks.
